y-m-35-01.title: |x−2|=2x−7: mhinduro dzevadzidzi vaviri dzakasiyana
y-m-35-01.topic: Ma equations ane absolute values: kutarisa kana ma candidates e chiitiko chimwe nechimwe achichengeta mamiriro echiitiko ichocho
y-m-35-01.goal: Pa equation ine absolute value, tonga nezvikonzero kuti ndeapi ema candidates akawanikwa nekupatsanura kuita zviitiko i mhinduro, uye udhiziine iwe pachako equation apo candidate inorasirwa.
y-m-35-01.material:
Vadzidzi vaviri vakagadzirisa equation |x − 2| = 2x − 7 (x i real number). Maitiro ekuverenga: '|x − 2| = 2x − 7' i 'absolute value ye x minus 2 equals 2x minus 7'. Vadzidzi vese vaviri vakatanga nekupatsanura kuita 'kana x ≥ 2' ne 'kana x < 2'.
· Kana x ≥ 2: kubva ku x − 2 = 2x − 7, x = 5 yakabuda.
· Kana x < 2: kubva ku −(x − 2) = 2x − 7, x = 3 yakabuda.
Mudzidzi 가 akapindura 'x = 3 kana x = 5', uye mudzidzi 나 akapindura 'x = 5'.

y-m-35-01.s.s1.r.d: Yakanganisa chikonzero chekupatsanura kuita zviitiko se 'inofanira kuva nemhinduro imwe'. Ma candidates echiitiko chimwe nechimwe anotariswa zvakaparadzana.
y-m-35-01.s.s1.explain: x = 3 i candidate kubva muchiitiko x < 2, asi 3 haisi shoma kupfuura 2, saka haisi mhinduro yechiitiko ichocho. Kuiisa mu equation yekutanga kunopawo |3 − 2| = 1 ne 2·3 − 7 = −1, izvo zvisingaenzani. x = 5 inogutsa 5 ≥ 2, uye |5 − 2| = 3 = 2·5 − 7, saka i mhinduro. Naizvozvo mhinduro imwe chete i x = 5.
y-m-35-01.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino, ngatidhiziine imwe iwe pachako. Pa equation yechimiro |x − a| = 2x − c (a ne c i integers, a ≥ 1), gadzira (a, c) 3 dzakasiyana apo mhinduro i x = 5 chete uye candidate yakawanikwa kubva muchiitiko x < a i kunze kwerange yechiitiko ichocho saka inorasirwa.
y-m-35-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wagadzirisa equation x − a = 2x − c yechiitiko x ≥ a kuti utaure x ne a ne c, uye unyore kuti hukama hupi pakati pe a ne c hunodiwa kuti mutengo uyu ive 5.
y-m-35-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isa a, wana c, wobva waverenga candidate kubva pa equation −(x − a) = 2x − c yechiitiko x < a uye uenzanise hukuru hwayo ne a.

y-m-35-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Mhinduro ye equation x − a = 2x − c yechiitiko x ≥ a haisi 5. Gadzirisa equation iyoyo iwe pachako.

y-m-35-01.s.s2.explain: Muchiitiko x ≥ a, x = c − a, saka c − a inofanira kuva 5. Kana candidate (a + c)/3 muchiitiko x < a isiri shoma kupfuura a, candidate iyoyo i kunze kwerange x < a uye inorasirwa. Kana c = a + 5, mamiriro aya akafanana ne a ≤ 5. Mienzaniso: (a, c) = (1, 6), (2, 7), (3, 8), (4, 9), (5, 10). Pa (5, 10), candidate i 5, yakaenzana nemuganhu, saka haigutsi x < 5 uye inorasirwa, uye mhinduro imwe chete i x = 5. Kune (6, 11), muchiitiko x ≥ 6, 5 i kunze kwerange, saka mhinduro haisi 5.

y-m-35-02.title: Real roots ye equation ine m, kana mamiriro achiwedzerwa rimwe pachimwe
y-m-35-02.topic: Discriminant ye quadratic equation nema letter coefficients: chiitiko apo leading coefficient i 0 nekududzira mamiriro edambudziko
y-m-35-02.goal: Pa equation ine letter mu coefficient, tarisa kuti i expression yemhando ipi usati washandisa discriminant, uye utonge kuti range yemhinduro inochinja sei kana mamiriro edambudziko achichinja.
y-m-35-02.material: m i real constant, uye tinofunga nezve real roots (roots dzine real numbers) ye expression mx² − 2x + 1 = 0 mu x. Maitiro ekuverenga: 'm x squared minus 2x plus 1 equals zero'. Discriminant ye quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 i D = b² − 4ac, uye pano b i even, saka unogonawo kuverenga D/4 = (−1)² − m·1 = 1 − m. Mushoko redambudziko rinoratidzwa zvishoma nezvishoma padanho rimwe nerimwe.
y-m-35-02.thinking.0: Kuchengeta kana kugadzirisa kutonga kwako kwekutanga zvichibva pamamiriro matsva
y-m-35-02.thinking.1: Kutarisa mamiriro apo discriminant inogona kushandiswa (kana i quadratic expression)
y-m-35-02.thinking.2: Kutsanangura kuti kunyange expression imwechete inopa mhinduro dzakasiyana zvichienderana nemamiriro
y-m-35-02.prereq.0: Hukama pakati pe discriminant D = b² − 4ac ye quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 nehuwandu hwe real roots
y-m-35-02.s.s1.prompt: Mushoko redambudziko rinoratidzwa danho nedanho. Padanho rimwe nerimwe, sarudza range yakarurama.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.hint.0: Isa nhamba chaidzo (semuenzaniso 1, 2, 0) pa m, gadzirisa equation zvakananga, uye uronge mutebhura kana pane real roots.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.hint.1: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, nyora mumutsetse mumwe kuti mamiriro api akachinja, uye utarise rimwe nerimwe kana mhinduro yedanho rekare ichiramba yakafanana.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.info: [Danho 1] Dambudziko: 'Kana equation mx² − 2x + 1 = 0 mu x ine real root, range ye real number m i ipi?' (Shoko rekuti 'quadratic equation' haripo.) Wakawana discriminant D/4 = 1 − m.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Range yakakodzera zvikuru ye m i ipi?
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Mushoko harina mashoko ekuti 'quadratic equation', saka m = 0 (expression inova −2x + 1 = 0 uye x = 1/2 i root) inobvumirwawo. Saka m ≤ 1 i mhinduro yakarurama yemushoko uyu. Zvakakosha kucherechedza, zvisinei, kuti m = 0 i chiitiko apo kuverenga discriminant hakushande.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: m < 1 — pane real root kana discriminant i positive chete
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kana D = 0 (double root) pane real root imwe zvakare, asi yakasiyiwa.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: m ≤ 1 — pane real root kana discriminant i 0 kana kupfuura
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Yakaverenga D ≥ 0 sezvayakaita. Kuti expression inochinja kana m = 0 hakuna kutariswa.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: m ≥ 1 — tora chiratidzo che inequality ye 1 − m ≥ 0 sezvazviri
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Nzira yechiratidzo che inequality yakanyorwa kumashure. Unogona kuziva nekugadzirisa D/4 = 1 − m ≥ 0.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: m ≤ 1 i mhinduro yekutanga, asi ndinoda kutarisa zvakaparadzana kana expression ichichinja kana m = 0
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Yakatanga kusahadzika chiitiko apo rudzi rwe expression runochinja.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.info: [Danho 2] Dambudziko rakagadziriswa: 'Kana quadratic equation mx² − 2x + 1 = 0 mu x ine real root, range ye real number m i ipi?'
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ikozvino range ye m i ipi?
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana i 'quadratic equation', m ≠ 0 inodiwa. Saka m ≤ 1 ne m ≠ 0. Mhinduro yedanho 1 haigone kushandiswa sezvayakaita pamushoko uyu.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Haina kuratidza kuti 'quadratic' yangoonekwa. Kune quadratic equation, unofanira kutarisa kana m = 0 ichigoneka.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Yakaverenga mamiriro ekuva ne real root se 'real roots mbiri dzakasiyana'. Double root ne D = 0 i real root zvakare.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Yakawedzera mamiriro ekuti, nekuti i quadratic equation, leading coefficient haifaniri kuva 0.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Yakafunga kuti m inofanira kuva positive. Kana ukaisa m = −1, −x² − 2x + 1 = 0 inewo real roots.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.info: [Danho 3] Dambudziko rakachinjazve: 'Kana quadratic equation mx² − 2x + 1 = 0 mu x ine real roots mbiri dzakasiyana, range ye real number m i ipi?'
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Panguva ino, range ye m i ipi?
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Kune real roots mbiri dzakasiyana, D > 0, uye i quadratic equation saka m ≠ 0. Saka m < 1 ne m ≠ 0.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Yakanganwa mamiriro ekuti i quadratic equation (m ≠ 0).
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: D = 0 haisi roots mbiri dzakasiyana asi double root (root imwe), asi yakasanganisirwa.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uku i kudivi apo D < 0. Muchiitiko icho hapana real roots.
y-m-35-02.s.s1.reflect: Kana wakasarudza 'm ≤ 1' mudanho 1, kutonga uku kwakanga kwakarurama pamushoko iwoyo. Asi mudanho 2 mamiriro akachinja uye mhinduro ye expression imwechete yakachinja. Wana nguva apo tsika yekutarisa 'i expression iyi i quadratic chaizvo here?' usati washandisa discriminant yakagadzirisa kutonga kwako.
y-m-35-02.s.s2.prompt: Nyora kuti sei unofanira kutarisa chiitiko m = 0 zvakaparadzana, uye muenzaniso wekuti mhinduro inosiyana sei zvichienderana nemushoko wedambudziko kunyange kune expression imwechete.
y-m-35-02.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora kuti expression yaunowana kana ukaisa m = 0 mu mx² − 2x + 1 = 0 i ipi.
y-m-35-02.s.s2.hint.1: Gadzirisa expression iyoyo kuona kana ine real root, uye uenzanise chiitiko apo dambudziko rinoti 'quadratic equation' nechiitiko apo rinoti 'equation' chete.
y-m-35-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakagadzirisa expression ne m = 0 iwe pachako uye wakasimbisa kuti ine root here?
y-m-35-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora zvakananga kuti mhinduro inosiyana sei kana mashoko ekuti 'quadratic equation' aripo uye kana asipo here?
y-m-35-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakafunga kuti discriminant i chishandiso che expression yemhando ipi here?
y-m-35-02.s.s2.model.0: Kana m = 0, quadratic term inonyangarika uye inova linear equation −2x + 1 = 0, uye x = 1/2 i real root. Kana dambudziko rinoti 'quadratic equation', mhinduro i m ≤ 1, m ≠ 0, ichisiya m = 0, uye kana rinoti 'equation' chete, mhinduro i m ≤ 1, ichisanganisira m = 0.
y-m-35-02.s.s2.model.1: Discriminant i chishandiso chinoshandiswa pa quadratic equations chete, saka m = 0 inotariswa zvakaparadzana. Kana m = 0, i −2x + 1 = 0 uye x = 0.5 i root. Saka zvichienderana nekuti mushoko rine 'quadratic' here, inopatsanuka kuita m ≤ 1 kana 'm ≤ 1 ne m ≠ 0'.

y-m-35-03.title: Chiratidzo chimwe chekuti huwandu hwema squares ema roots maviri i 10 chakakwana here?
y-m-35-03.topic: Hukama pakati pema roots nema coefficients: ma coefficients anosarudzwa here kana huwandu hwema squares ema roots maviri chete huzivikanwa?
y-m-35-03.goal: Shandura mamiriro kuita expression mu coefficients uchishandisa hukama pakati pema roots nema coefficients, wobva watonga kana mamiriro iwayo oga achisarudza ma coefficients uye utaure kuti chii chimwe chinodiwa.
y-m-35-03.material: p ne q i real numbers, uye ma roots maviri e quadratic equation x² + px + q = 0 mu x i real numbers α ne β. (Maitiro ekuverenga: 'x squared plus p x plus q equals zero'.) Chinhu chega chatinoziva i α² + β² = 10 (alpha squared plus beta squared i ten).
y-m-35-03.thinking.1: Kugadzira mienzaniso yakawanda inogutsa mamiriro uye kutarisa mamiriro e real-root
y-m-35-03.thinking.2: Kuedza kana ruzivo rwekuwedzera rwunosarudza ma coefficients sechimwe
y-m-35-03.prereq.0: Hukama pakati pema roots nema coefficients e quadratic equation: huwandu hwema roots maviri = −(coefficient ye x), product = constant term (kana coefficient ye x² i 1)
y-m-35-03.s.s1.prompt: Chii chinoitika ku (p, q) neruzivo urwu oga?
y-m-35-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora α + β ne αβ nema p ne q, wobva wanyora zvakare α² + β² uchishandisa (α + β)² ne αβ.
y-m-35-03.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga kuti ma equations mangani pakati pe p ne q anobuda, uye uwane nekuisa rimwe nerimwe (p, q) dzinogutsa equation iyi.
y-m-35-03.s.s1.o.a: Inosarudzwa sechimwe — neruzivo urwu, p ne q imwe neimwe inobuda semutengo mumwe
y-m-35-03.s.s1.r.a: Yakafungidzira kuti equation imwe inogona kusarudza zvisinazvozvizivikanwi zviviri.
y-m-35-03.s.s1.o.b: Hazvisarudzwi — pangava nemapeya akati wandei (p, q) anogutsa ruzivo urwu
y-m-35-03.s.s1.o.c: Hazvigoni kutongwa — hatigone kuziva kana ma roots i real, saka hapana chinogona kutaurwa
y-m-35-03.s.s1.r.c: Zvinyorwa zvinoti ma roots i real. Yakasiya mamiriro akapiwa.
y-m-35-03.s.s1.o.d: p inosarudzwa uye q chete i yakasununguka — nekuti p² i 10
y-m-35-03.s.s1.r.d: Mu expression α² + β² = p² − 2q, haina kuona chikamu che q.
y-m-35-03.s.s1.explain: α + β = −p ne αβ = q, saka α² + β² = (α + β)² − 2αβ = p² − 2q. Ruzivo i equation imwe chete p² − 2q = 10, saka mapeya akati wandei anogoneka, sa (p, q) = (4, 3), (2, −3), (0, −5) (unofanirawo kutarisa kuti ma roots i real).
y-m-35-03.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapeya matatu akasiyana (p, q) anogutsa ruzivo α² + β² = 10 uye ane ma roots maviri i real, pachiitiko apo p ne q i integers zvese.
y-m-35-03.s.s2.hint.0: Uchishandisa ruzivo rwakanyorwa se equation mu p ne q, verenga kuti q inosarudzwa sei kana wagadzirisa p.
y-m-35-03.s.s2.hint.1: Pa peya imwe neimwe yawakawana, verenga simbi ye discriminant p² − 4q kuti utarise kuti ma roots i real.
y-m-35-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Sarudza p ne q se integers.
y-m-35-03.s.s2.fail.c2: α² + β² haiiti 10. Verenga uchishandisa α + β = −p ne αβ = q.
y-m-35-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Discriminant isina, saka maroots maviri haasi real.
y-m-35-03.s.s2.explain: Mapeya emaintegers anoita p² − 2q = 10 ne p² − 4q ≥ 0 i(±4, 3), (±2, −3), (0, −5). (6, 13) inoita p² − 2q = 10, asi discriminant yayo i36 − 52 < 0, saka maroots i3 ± 2i (imaginary). Nemaroots eimaginary, kunyange α² + β² = 10 ichishanda, mamiriro e 'maroots ari real' anoputswa.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.prompt: Kana p ne q zviri real, sarudza sarudzo dzose dzinoita kuti kuwedzera chimwe chete chezvinotevera kuchiratidzo α² + β² = 10 kusarudze (p, q) kuita imwe.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.hint.0: Pasarudzo yega yega, ibatanidze ne p² − 2q = 10, wana p kana q, uye uverenge kuti mhedzisiro dzakawanda sei dzinobuda.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kusarudzo inopa mhinduro mbiri kana kupfuura, ongorora kana mumwe nemumwe achiita mamiriro ediscriminant p² − 4q ≥ 0.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.r.a: Kana q = 3, saka p² = 16, saka zvose p = 4 ne p = −4 zvinogoneka. Kunyange mugumisiro uri mumwe chete, chiratidzo che p chinoramba chiripo.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.r.c: Kubatanidza equation inowanikwa nekuisa 1 nechiratidzo kunopa mikana miviri ye (p, q). Zviri nyore kunzwa kuti kuziva root imwe kunokwana.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.r.e: Mamiriro echiratidzo anopfupisa chiyero chete uye haasarudze kukosha kuita kumwe. Nhamba dzakawanda zvisingaperi dzereal p dzinosara.
y-m-35-03.s.s3.explain: Kana huwandu i−2, p = 2 ne q = (4 − 10)/2 = −3 zvakasarudzwa. Kana mugumisiro i−5, p² = 0, saka p = 0 yakasarudzwa. Kana mugumisiro i3, pane mapeya maviri, (4, 3) ne(−4, 3), uye kana root imwe i1, pane mapeya maviri, (2, −3) ne(−4, 3). Kana maroots maviri ose akanaka, kune real number p yega yega ine −2√5 ≤ p < −√10 pane q = (p² − 10)/2, saka pane zvisingaperi.

y-m-35-08.title: Ma cubic equations mangani ane roots 1 ne2?
y-m-35-08.topic: Cubic equations: hukama pakati pe root yasara ne coefficients kana roots mbiri dzapiwa
y-m-35-08.goal: Tarisa nekugadzira mienzaniso kuti kana roots mbiri chete dze cubic equation dzapiwa, ma coefficients haatarwi seimwe, uye root yasara ndiyo inotara ma coefficients.
y-m-35-08.material: a, b, ne c ndema integer, uye f(x) = x³ + ax² + bx + c. Nzira yekuverenga: 'x cubed plus a x squared plus b x plus c'. Chaunoziva ndechekuti root imwe ye equation f(x) = 0 ndi1 uye imwe root ndi2 (hauzivi root yechitatu).
y-m-35-08.thinking.1: Kugadzira mhinduro dzakawanda uchishandisa factor theorem
y-m-35-08.thinking.2: Kuwana mutemo kubva mumienzaniso (hukama pakati pe root yechitatu ne a)
y-m-35-08.prereq.0: Kuverenga nekuisa kukosha kwe x mu polynomial
y-m-35-08.s.s1.prompt: Neruzivo urwu chete, unogona kutaura chii nezve a, b, c ne root yechitatu?
y-m-35-08.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora f(1) = 0 ne f(2) = 0 seequations mu a, b, ne c. Verenga kuti ma equations mangani uye ma unknowns mangani.
y-m-35-08.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa iwe pachako kana kugadzirisa a kunotara b ne c, uye utsvage kuti root yechitatu inova chii ipapo.
y-m-35-08.s.s1.o.a: Root yechitatu inofanirawo kuva 3 — nekuti ndiyo nhamba inotevera 1, 2
y-m-35-08.s.s1.r.a: Iko kufungidzira, kwete mutemo. Equation ine roots 1, 2, 3 muenzaniso mumwe chete.
y-m-35-08.s.s1.o.b: Sum yema roots matatu yakatarwa, saka a inotarwa seimwe kukosha; sum ndi −a
y-m-35-08.s.s1.r.b: Zvechokwadi kuti sum ndi −a, asi kana usingazivi root yechitatu, hauzivi sum zvakare.
y-m-35-08.s.s1.o.c: a, b, ne c dzose dzakatarwa seimwe — roots mbiri dzapiwa
y-m-35-08.s.s1.r.c: Hazvina kucherechedza kuti pane 2 equations asi 3 unknowns.
y-m-35-08.s.s1.o.d: Kana root yechitatu (kana a) yagadziriswa, zvimwe zvinotarwa — pane kukosha kumwe chete kwakasununguka
y-m-35-08.s.s1.explain: f(1) = 0 ne f(2) = 0 ndi2 equations mu a, b, ne c. Imwe yema unknowns 3 inosara yakasununguka. Semuenzaniso, kana wagadzirisa a, b = −7 − 3a ne c = −1 − a − b zvinotarwa.
y-m-35-08.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira (a, b, c) 3, dzine a dzakasiyana, dze equations dzine roots matatu ari ma positive integers akasiyana uye maviri acho ari 1 ne2.
y-m-35-08.s.s2.hint.0: Gadzirisa root yechitatu seinteger ye3 kana kupfuura, wozowedzera (x − 1)(x − 2)(x − nhamba yawakasarudza) uye uverenge ma coefficients.
y-m-35-08.s.s2.hint.1: Panzvimbo pekuwedzera, unogonawo kugadzirisa ma equations maviri f(1) = 0 ne f(2) = 0. Tarisa kuti root yechitatu ipositive integer yakasiyana chaizvo.
y-m-35-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota sarudza a, b, c seema integer.
y-m-35-08.s.s2.ok.c4: Roots matatu ndema positive integers akasiyana.
y-m-35-08.s.s2.fail.c4: Roots matatu haasi ma positive integers akasiyana. Tsvaga root yechitatu iwe pachako uye uienzanise ne1 ne2.
y-m-35-08.s.s2.explain: Kana root yechitatu ndi r, saka f(x) = (x − 1)(x − 2)(x − r), uye a = −(3 + r), b = 2 + 3r, c = −2r. Kana r = 3, 4, 5, 6, saka (a, b, c) = (−6, 11, −6), (−7, 14, −8), (−8, 17, −10), (−9, 20, −12). (−3, 2, 0) ine root yechitatu 0, uye mu (−5, 8, −4) 2 inodzokororwa, saka haasi ma positive integers akasiyana.
y-m-35-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Uchitarisa mienzaniso yawakawana, nyora mumutsara mumwe kana miviri kuti hukama hupi huripo pakati pe 'kukosha kwe a' ne 'root yechitatu'.
y-m-35-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kune (a, b, c) 3 dzawakawana, tsvaga root yechitatu (root isiri 1 kana 2) uye uinyore padivi pe a.
y-m-35-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti root yechitatu inochinja sei kana a ichidzikira danho rimwe.
y-m-35-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakabatanidza here a ne root yechitatu mumienzaniso yawakawana?
y-m-35-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Unogona kupfupisa hukama mumutsara mumwe here (unogona kufanofungidzira a mumuenzaniso unotevera here)?
y-m-35-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora uchiziva here kuti 1 ne2 dzinoramba dzakadaro uye root yechitatu chete ndiyo inochinja?
y-m-35-08.s.s2.because.model.0: Sum yema roots matatu ndi −a, saka 1 + 2 + (root yechitatu) = −a, uye root yechitatu ndi −a − 3. Kana a = −6, root yechitatu ndi3, uye kana a = −7, ndi4.

y-m-35-06.topic: Maequation edegree yakakwira: mamiriro ekusarasa mhinduro kana mutaurire mumwe uri kumativi ose maviri
y-m-35-06.goal: Kune equation ine mutaurire mumwe kumativi ose maviri, wana kwakatanga kukanganisa mukugadzirisa, tonga nyaya dzipi dzausingarasi mhinduro, uye ugadzire equation umo mhinduro inorasika.
y-m-35-06.material: Iyi mhinduro yemudzidzi kuequation (x − 3)(x + 2) = (x − 3)(x + 1) (x inhamba chaiyo). Maitiro ekuverenga: '(x − 3)(x + 2) equals (x − 3)(x + 1)'.
y-m-35-06.thinking.1: Kutonga mamiriro umo unogona kudzima mutaurire mumwe
y-m-35-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga mukugadzirisa uku umo dambudziko rinomuka.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti kuverenga kupi kwakabva mumutsara wakangotangira kune mutsara wega wega, uye uongorore imwe neimwe kana kuverenga uku kuchigona kuitwa kune nhamba chaiyo x yega yega.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira kana mutaurire wakashandiswa mumutsara unokahadzika uchigona kuva 0, uye kana pane x yakadaro, iise zvakananga muequation yekutanga uye uverenge divi rega rega.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.line.0: Mu (x − 3)(x + 2) = (x − 3)(x + 1), mutaurire mumwe (x − 3) uri kumativi ose maviri.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.line.1: Kugovanisa mativi ose maviri ne (x − 3) kunopa x + 2 = x + 1.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.explain: Mumutsara 2, mativi ose maviri akagoverwa ne x − 3, asi kana x = 3 saka x − 3 = 0 uye haugoni kugovanisa ne0. Nyaya iyoyo haina kuongororwa wega, saka 'hapana mhinduro' inotevera mumutsara 4 mhedziso isina kururamawo (mutsara 4 hausi pakatanga dambudziko asi mugumisiro waro). Chaizvo, kana ukaisa x = 3, mativi ose maviri i0, saka x = 3 imhinduro.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.prompt: Kuti urege kurasa mhinduro munzira yekugovanisa mutaurire mumwe (x − 3) kumativi ose maviri, zvipi zvinotevera zvinobatsira? Sarudza zvose zvinoshanda.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.hint.0: Fungidzira kutanga watsvaga x chero inoita divisor 0, wobva waona kuti chii chinoitika kana ukaisa kukosha iko muequation yekutanga.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.hint.1: Pasarudzo yega yega, fungidzira kana 'x umo mhinduro inogona kurasika' yasara kana kwete.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.o.a: Kana mutaurire mumwe uri kumativi ose maviri, unogona kugovanisa nguva ipi neipi, saka govanisa pakarepo
y-m-35-06.s.s2.r.a: Yakashaya kuti haugoni kugovanisa pamakosha anoita divisor 0.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.o.b: Isa makosha e x anoita divisor 0 wega muequation yekutanga uye uongorore kana ari mhinduro
y-m-35-06.s.s2.o.c: Kana kupokana (2 = 1) kukabuda mushure mekugovanisa, tora equation yekutanga seyakapokanawo
y-m-35-06.s.s2.r.c: Equation yakagoverwa neequation yekutanga hadzigone kuva equation imwe chete. Kupokana kuri mugumisiro weequation yakagoverwa chete.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.o.d: Govanisa chete kana divisor isina kumbova 0 kunhamba chaiyo chero ipi (semuenzaniso, x² + 1)
y-m-35-06.s.s2.explain: Kana pasina x inoita divisor 0 (d), kugovanisa hakurasi mhinduro. Kana pane x inoiita 0, unofanira kuisa kukosha iko wega muequation yekutanga kuongorora (b). Kuti ugadzirise pakarepo, pane nzira yekutamira zvose kudivi rimwe ukafactor (mugumisiro i0).
y-m-35-06.s.s3.prompt: Muchimiro che (x − a)(x + b) = (x − a)(2x + c), umo a, b, c maintegers kubva pa−9 kusvika pa9, gadzira (a, b, c) matatu, ane misanganiswa yemhinduro yakasiyana, yemaequation umo mudzidzi anogovanisa mativi ose maviri ne (x − a) arasa mhinduro imwe (mhinduro idzi kukosha kuviri kwakasiyana).
y-m-35-06.s.s3.hint.0: Unganidza mativi ose maviri kudivi rimwe uye ubudise (x − a) sefactor, uye uwane x inoita mutaurire wakasara 0.
y-m-35-06.s.s3.hint.1: Kana x iyoyo yakaenzana ne a, pane mhinduro imwe chete, saka sarudza b ne c kuti ive yakasiyana ne a.
y-m-35-06.s.s3.ok.c1: Nhamba nhatu idzi maintegers mukati mechiyero.
y-m-35-06.s.s3.fail.c1: Ndapota sarudza a, b, c semaintegers kubva pa−9 kusvika pa9.
y-m-35-06.s.s3.fail.c2: Pane mhinduro imwe chete. Mushure mekubudisa (x − a) sefactor, mhinduro yemutaurire wakasara inofanira kusiyana ne a.
y-m-35-06.s.s3.explain: (x − a)(x + b) − (x − a)(2x + c) = (x − a)(b − c − x), saka mhinduro ndi x = a ne x = b − c. Kana a ≠ b − c pane mhinduro mbiri, uye kuparadzanisa ne (x − a) kunopa x = b − c chete. Muenzaniso: (3, 2, 1) → mhinduro 3, 1. Mienzaniso ine musanganiswa mumwe chete we (a, b − c) inoverengwa seimwe.

y-m-35-07.title: Kana discriminant iri negative, inogara iri positive here? Kuenzanisa mhinduro mbiri
y-m-35-07.topic: Mamiriro ekuti quadratic inequality ishande kune real numbers dzose: discriminant nechiratidzo che leading coefficient
y-m-35-07.goal: Enzanisa uye utonge mhinduro mbiri dzemamiriro apo quadratic expression iri positive kune real numbers dzose, uratidze kukanganisa kwemhinduro imwe nemuenzaniso unopikisa, uye unyore mamiriro akakwana.
y-m-35-07.material:
k ndi real constant, uye nyaya ndeyekuti 'Tsvaga renji re k apo inequality kx² − 4x + k > 0 inoshanda kune real numbers x dzose'. Nzira yekuverenga: 'k x squared minus 4x plus k is greater than zero'.
Mhinduro A: Kuti graph igare iri pamusoro pe x-axis, haifaniri kusangana ne x-axis, saka D/4 = 4 − k² < 0, ndiko kuti k² > 4. Saka k > 2 kana k < −2.
Mhinduro B: Pakati pe k > 2 kana k < −2 yakawanikwa mu A, graph inofanira kuva padivi repamusoro, saka k > 0 inodiwawo. Saka k > 2.
y-m-35-07.thinking.1: Kugadzira muenzaniso unopikisa kuratidza kukanganisa kwekupfuvura
y-m-35-07.thinking.2: Kuziva mamiriro akasiiwa (chiratidzo che leading coefficient) nekugadzirisa mhinduro
y-m-35-07.prereq.0: Chimiro che graph ye quadratic function y = ax² + bx + c ne discriminant D = b² − 4ac
y-m-35-07.prereq.1: Pfungwa huru yemamiriro ekuti quadratic inequality ax² + bx + c > 0 ishande kune real numbers dzose (hukama pakati pe graph ne x-axis)
y-m-35-07.s.s1.prompt: Nzira ipi yakakodzera zvakanyanya yekutonga mhinduro mbiri idzi?
y-m-35-07.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza k = −3 kubva pa renji ra A, uise x = 0 mu kx² − 4x + k, uye utarise kana kukosha kuri positive.
y-m-35-07.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana graph iri pamusoro kana pazasi pe x-axis kana k = 3 uye kana k = −3.
y-m-35-07.s.s1.o.a: A yakarurama — kana D < 0, graph haisangani ne x-axis, saka inogara ichishanda
y-m-35-07.s.s1.r.a: Yakatora kusasangana ne x-axis nekuva 'pamusoro' pe x-axis sezvinhu zvimwe chete.
y-m-35-07.s.s1.o.b: Vose A ne B vakanganisa — havana kutarisa zvakasiyana nyaya dzek = 0 kana D = 0
y-m-35-07.s.s1.r.b: Vose k = 0 ne D = 0 vakatosiiwa mumhinduro. Kana ukatarisa, hapana inogutsa mamiriro.
y-m-35-07.s.s1.o.c: B yakarurama — kunze kwe D < 0, mamiriro ekutungamira kwe graph (chiratidzo che k) anodiwa
y-m-35-07.s.s1.o.d: Vose A ne B vakarurama — vakawana renji rimwe chete nenzira dzakasiyana
y-m-35-07.s.s1.r.d: Hazvina kucherechedza kuti mhinduro dzaA naB dzakasiyana.
y-m-35-07.s.s1.explain: Kana D < 0, graph haisangani ne x-axis, asi kana k < 0, graph yose iri pazasi pe x-axis, saka kx² − 4x + k > 0 haizombo ichishanda. Saka k > 0 inodiwawo uye mhinduro ndi k > 2. (Kana k = 2, saka D = 0 uye kukosha ndi0 pa x = 1, saka hazvibvumirwi.)
y-m-35-07.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira muenzaniso unopikisa: k iri mukati me renji ra A (k > 2 kana k < −2) asi iyo mamiriro enyaya ino asingashande. Gadzira (k, x) mbiri ane k dzakasiyana dzine k < −2 uye kx² − 4x + k ≤ 0.
y-m-35-07.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza k imwe kubva pa renji ra A, senge −3, uye uverenge kukosha kwe expression uchichinja x kuita 0, 1, 2.
y-m-35-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kana pane x imwe chete apo kukosha kwe expression kuri 0 kana pasi, (k, x) iyoyo muenzaniso unopikisa. Nyaya apo kukosha kuri positive haisi muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-35-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Iri mukati me renji ra A k < −2.
y-m-35-07.s.s2.fail.c1: k haisi mukati me renji ra A (k < −2).
y-m-35-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Pa x iyoyo, kukosha kwe expression kuri 0 kana pasi, saka mamiriro anoputsika.
y-m-35-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Pa x iyi, kukosha kwe expression kuri positive. Edza imwe x.
y-m-35-07.s.s2.explain: Kana k < 0, kukosha kwe expression pa x = 0 ndi k, saka kwatova negative. Semuenzaniso, (−3, 0) inopa −3, (−4, 1) inopa −12, uye (−5, 2) inopa −33. Muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa unogona kuratidza kuti renji ra A harina kururama.
y-m-35-07.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mumutsara mumwe kana miviri chakasiiwa mumhinduro ya A, uye uzadzise renji re k apo 'kx² − 4x + k > 0 kune real numbers x dzose'.
y-m-35-07.s.s3.hint.0: Chinja k kuita −3, 0, 3 uye utarise iwe pachako kana graph iri pamusoro pe x-axis.
y-m-35-07.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora zvakaparadzana zvakatarisirwa nemhinduro ya A (graph haisangani ne x-axis) uye zvisati zvatarisirwa (kana iri pamusoro kana pazasi pe x-axis).
y-m-35-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaisa here kukosha kumwe kwe k kubva pa renji rawakanyora (semuenzaniso 3) kuti utarise kuti inogara iri positive chaizvo?
y-m-35-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora uchiziva here kuti D < 0 zvinongoreva 'graph haisangani ne x-axis'?
y-m-35-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakatarisa here kuti nei k = 2 isingashande?
y-m-35-07.s.s3.model.0: A yakatarisa discriminant chete uye haina kutarisa chiratidzo che k. Kana k < 0, graph inovhurika nechepasi kwete nechepamusoro, saka iri pazasi pe x-axis uye inogara iri negative. Saka k > 0 inodiwa, uye mhinduro ndi k > 2.
y-m-35-07.s.s3.model.1: D < 0 inongoreva kuti haisangani ne x-axis, uye kuti iri pamusoro kana pazasi pe x-axis zvinotongwa nechiratidzo che leading coefficient k. Kuti ive yakakura kupfuura 0 kune x dzose, k > 0 inodiwa, saka kubatanidza ne k² > 4 kunopa k > 2.
